title: Migrate project and bootstrap source root
summary: Move project resolution, setup/bootstrap execution, starter templates, and local project storage helpers into src/project/** while preserving bootstrap/config behavior.

goal.outcome: Project loading, root resolution, setup/bootstrap use cases, templates, file store/filesystem, and git cache have source-root ownership under src/project/**.
acceptance: Create src/project/** owner modules for project types, loadProject/context, root resolution, setup/bootstrap use cases/tool execution, starter templates, file store/filesystem, and git cache as applicable.
Update adapters/scripts/tests to import project/bootstrap behavior from src/project/** or stable public API paths, not old project/application owner paths.
Remove old project/bootstrap owner paths or retain only explicit temporary shims with TASK-specific tests.
Preserve wiki-bootstrap/wiki-config schemas/results, starter output, package loading, direct Node execution, and smoke behavior.
Add TASK-specific guard proving old project/bootstrap owner imports are gone or explicitly shimmed.
non_goals: Do not migrate knowledge, roadmap, session, state/graph/resume, GC, change/diff-table, adapters/UI, skills, or final API/shared cleanup.
Do not change public tool schemas, package entrypoints, starter file contents, or bootstrap product behavior.
